invariants.rationale: The minAmount should not be greater than maxAmount for the split pane to function correctly.
splitAmount typically represents a normalized position and should be between 0 and 1 inclusive.
style and style.handle are accessed unconditionally in the method, so they must not be null.
Both firstWidget and secondWidget are used in the method, so they are expected to be non-null to avoid NullPointerExceptions.
Widget dimensions such as width and height are expected to be non-negative.
